comparison: Locked deployed v3.1 setting versus locked original_full setting; no search, early stopping, threshold tuning or deployment changes
learning_curve_scope: Existing TRAIN split only. Whole-family, nested, event-balanced subsets within each outer training fold. Fixed settings were selected previously using the same training pool; these are exploratory post-selection curves, not unbiased replacement accuracy estimates.
error_scope: Existing validation/test native saved predictions, plus paired-label ambiguity in each existing split. Retrospective diagnostic use only; outcomes and derived realized multipliers are never training features.
boundary_window_origin: Predeclared descriptive windows, not learned thresholds, approval decisions or empirical market statistics
outcome_reference: Analytic conditional probability under the existing independent uniform common-cost/receipts shock model, ignoring cent rounding. Simulator-only diagnostic, never real-world risk or a calibrated ML prediction.
